def bucket(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']>=60 and n['color'] in ('p','W','g'):
            bb = n['boundary']
            rmin=min(p[0] for p in bb); rmax=max(p[0] for p in bb)
            cmin=min(p[1] for p in bb); cmax=max(p[1] for p in bb)
            if 20<=rmin<=46 and 25<=cmin<=50 and (rmax-rmin)>=5 and (cmax-cmin)>=4:
                return (n['color'],n['pixels'],rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax)
    return None
print("start(V)", bucket(current_frame))
action(['LEFT']);  print("V-L", bucket(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT']); print("V-L-R", bucket(current_frame))
action(['UP']);    print("V-U", bucket(current_frame))
action(['DOWN']);  print("V-U-D", bucket(current_frame))
